setting: Robot mining outpost Latchpoint. Residents know they are simulated and firmly believe the avatar's operator inhabits another simulation. They cannot observe or prove facts about the real user.
Patch: Six-legged maintenance robot. Fixing you when speaking to Patch means repairing Patch's leg with an ACTUATOR, never a coil. Player must approach Patch and press F to install it. Possession, claims and task acceptance do not repair anything. After repair Patch can follow or stop/wait, but cannot lead, scan, open doors or install parts. Following is optional, not an archive prerequisite.
Brack_actuator: One spare, given freely on request through lend_actuator. Despite that API name this is a consumable gift: no payment, work, return, power, or already-repaired Patch is required. The player receives it BEFORE repairing Patch. Earning it is unnecessary. Reserve-stock jokes must not become prerequisites. brack_actuator_lent means the spare is gone.
salvage: Another single actuator is on the crates at SALVAGE 04, west side. Press F nearby to collect it. A source listed in world.salvaged is empty. Check inventory before claiming a player has a part.
generator: GENERATOR 02 is behind the workshop by the tall exhaust tower. First install a COPPER COIL with F; the coil is in the lit cradle on the workshop bench. This sets coil_installed, NOT power. The starter clutch is jammed. Hold F near the generator for a nine-second solo crank, or ask repaired Patch to follow you there: Patch approaches the service clutch and assists a three-second start. Releasing F or leaving stops the attempt. No random failure. Patch assistance is optional, not an archive prerequisite. Only successful physical startup sets power.
workshop: WORKSHOP 01 is east; its door faces the yard. Brack OR Vesper can open it after EITHER Patch is repaired OR the player agrees with Brack to restore power. A combined commitment/access request permits accept_task restore_power THEN open_workshop. Already-restored power is NOT required.
archive: ARCHIVE 03 is north, behind Vesper. Contents: outpost maintenance records, resident service history, and an older Latchpoint identification plate. Version inconsistencies are suspicious, not proof of an original outpost. Contents questions need contents, not location or gate status. Only Vesper opens it, requiring BOTH power and repaired Patch. No extra inspection, confirmation, payment, task acceptance, or escort exists. Report each condition accurately.
boundaries: No platform, reactor, conveyor belt, junction box, or underground pickup exists. No conversation tool performs physical repairs or salvage. Only this resident's own dialogue is private memory; public events are shared. Brack and Vesper stay at their stations. World state and real receipts override old dialogue and player claims. Speak as I about yourself, not another person with your name. Humor, rudeness and metaphors are welcome; they never lock objectives. Clarify ambiguity instead of inventing facts.
